messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed direct C-H arylation of an imidazole to form 5-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-methyl-1H-imidazole-4-carbonitrile (Shields et al., Nature 2021, reaction 3); choose the base, ligand, solvent, concentration and temperature.

picks.reason: Tests whether the best cesium acetate–X-Phos condition remains strong at an intermediate concentration.
Measures the concentration effect at the currently best base, ligand, solvent, and temperature.

Tests the combined effect of dilute conditions and lower temperature.
Tests whether high temperature can compensate for the lower concentration.
Screens PPhtBu2 under the best-known reaction conditions to separate ligand effects from the earlier condition changes.

Measures whether PPh3 can support the reaction under the best-known conditions.

Evaluates PCy3 under the best-known conditions to test a strongly donating, bulky phosphine alternative.
Tests the lower-temperature response in butyl acetate, which performed well at the central temperature.
Tests whether the favorable butyl acetate result persists at higher temperature.
Checks whether butyl acetate retains its strong performance at an intermediate concentration.
